337550.summary: What is the minimum number required to perform Eid Salah as we have so many restrictions on gatherings . The fuqaha’ differed regarding the number of people required to do the Eid prayer. Some of them, such as the Hanbalis, stipulated that there should be forty people. Others, such as the Shaafa‘is, said that it is permissible for one who is alone to offer the Eid prayer. The view that is more likely to be correct is that the number required is three. We have noted above that the more correct view is that the number required for Jumu‘ah is three, so this is based on that.
query_phrases: The number of people required to do the Eid prayer

405232.summary: In Ramadan, an hour before Fajr, my period had still not ended. That is because the principle is that the event should be attributed to the closest time. Moreover, the condition of the fast being valid is ascertaining that the period had ended before Fajr, so it is not valid to fast when there is uncertainty about that.

405311.summary: Many scholars interpret the hadith “Whoever prays with the imam until he finishes, it will be recorded for him as having prayed all night” as referrin. Then when five nights were left, he led us in qiyam until nearly half of the night had gone. The Prophet (blessings and peace of Allah be upon him) said these words on the second night on which he led his companions (may Allah be pleased with them) in praying qiyam.
